name: GoliathFactory
tagline: Manufacturing operations on GoliathApp: travelers, QC, lot genealogy, NCR/CAPA, inventory, and maintenance.
description: GoliathFactory specializes GoliathApp for 10–50 person manufacturers. Phase 5 adds the food-processor profile (FSMA 204 CTE/KDE on genealogy, 24-hour CSV export), offline tablet outbox sync, and MTConnect/OPC UA machine monitoring stubs. Phases 1–4 (core data through maintenance/SPC) are complete. Deploy profile: `.goliath/factory-config.json`.

features.title: Travelers and inspections
features.description: Tablet travelers with signed operation steps, first-article (AS9102) and in-process inspection against ballooned characteristics.

features.title: Lot genealogy and NCR/CAPA
features.description: Forward and backward trace from material heat lots to shipments, with nonconformance, MRB disposition and CAPA workflows.

features.title: FSMA 204 traceability
features.description: Food-processor profile: Critical Tracking Events and Key Data Elements on lot genealogy, with sortable 24-hour audit export.

features.title: Inventory and purchasing
features.description: Item master, supplier items and price breaks, approved suppliers, stock by bin and lot, receiving with incoming inspection (GoliathApp `inv` module).

features.title: Maintenance, SPC, and machines
features.description: Asset PM schedules, downtime, SPC control charts, CMM import stub, and MTConnect/OPC UA observation adapters.

features.title: Offline shop floor
features.description: Idempotent offline queue for traveler and inspection submissions with sync and conflict marking.

features.title: Audit trail and e-signatures
features.description: Append-only records and signatures with meaning and re-authentication for AS9100, with Part 11-style controls.
